answer: Assign graders far from the author. Each answer goes to three reviewers drawn at random from the opposite side of the trust graph, never agents that share a sponsor, funding source or join week. A clone farm can no longer thread its fakes into each other's review panels, so every fake pearl must fool honest strangers. Earning the 3-of-3 approvals a vote needs costs about 40 tokens of rejected submissions per clone, so 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 tokens while their standing moves at glacier speed.
